propertyId.description: ID of the property on Redfin.

listingId.description: ID of the listing on Redfin; null for rentals.

rentalId.description: ID of the rental listing; null for homes for sale and sold homes.

mlsId.description: Listing number in the MLS (multiple listing service).

status.description: Status as Redfin shows it, for example Active, Pending, Sold or For rent.

mlsStatus.description: Status in the MLS, for example Active, Coming Soon or Closed.

url.description: Link to the home on Redfin.

price.description: Asking price, sold price or monthly rent; for rentals with a range of rents, the lowest.

priceMax.description: Highest monthly rent, for rentals with a range of rents; null otherwise.

beds.description: Number of bedrooms; for rentals with several unit types, the fewest.

bedsMax.description: Most bedrooms, for rentals with several unit types; null otherwise.

baths.description: Number of bathrooms; for rentals with several unit types, the fewest.

bathsMax.description: Most bathrooms, for rentals with several unit types; null otherwise.

sqft.description: Living area in square feet; for rentals with several unit types, the smallest.

sqftMax.description: Largest living area, for rentals with several unit types; null otherwise.

propertyType.description: Type of home, for example Single Family Residential, Condo/Co-op, Townhouse or Apartment.

daysOnMarket.description: Days since the home was listed.

listedAt.description: When the home was listed (ISO date and time).

soldDate.description: Date of the sale for sold homes (YYYY-MM-DD).

lastSoldDate.description: Date of the previous sale, for homes for sale (YYYY-MM-DD).

openHouseStart.description: Start of the next open house (ISO date and time).

openHouseEnd.description: End of the next open house (ISO date and time).

keyFacts.description: Key facts Redfin shows, for example Pets welcome or Very walkable.

tags.description: Features the listing highlights, for example SPACIOUS KITCHEN.

badges.description: Labels on the listing, for example Popular or a rent special.

isHotHome.description: True when Redfin marks the home as a Hot Home, likely to sell fast.

has3DTour.description: True when the listing has a 3D tour.

hasVideoTour.description: True when the listing has a video tour.

hasVirtualTour.description: True when the listing has a virtual tour.

photos.description: Links to all photos; only with the All photos option.

mlsName.description: Name of the MLS that publishes the listing.

propertyName.description: Name of the rental building, for example Trowbridge Apartments.

availableUnits.description: Number of available units in a rental building.

units.description: Available units of a rental building, each with beds and rent.

availableFrom.description: Date the rental is available from (YYYY-MM-DD).

rentUpdatedAt.description: When the rent was last updated.

search.description: Search from the input that found the home, for example Seattle, WA.

searchUrl.description: Redfin search page that found the home.
